name: Joel
overview: Joel is a male prophet identified as the son of Pethuel, known primarily for his prophetic ministry as recorded in the book that bears his name. His tribal affiliation and additional biographical details are not specified in Scripture. The designation 'the prophet' highlights his role as a divinely inspired messenger to the people of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Joel means 'YHWH is God [El],' reflecting a declaration of the sovereignty of the Lord. This proper name underscores the central biblical truth of God's supremacy, which aligns with Joel's prophetic message. The name is directly referenced in Joel 1:1.
familyAndRelationships: Joel is explicitly identified as the son of Pethuel, establishing a singular familial relationship recorded in Scripture. No other family connections are documented beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Joel's significance lies in his role as a prophet through whom God communicated His messages to His people. His identity as the son of Pethuel and his prophetic office situate him within the biblical tradition of divinely appointed messengers. While further details about his life and ministry are not provided, his contribution is preserved in the prophetic book that bears his name, emphasizing God's sovereignty and calling His people to repentance.
